parts.problem_md:
The frequency table shows information about the number of books read by some students in a reading marathon.

| Number of books read | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Frequency | $2$ | $2$ | $16$ | $10$ | $9$ | $4$ | $x$ | $2$ |

i) The mean number of books read is 4.28.

Find the value of $x$.

$x=$.................................................. [3]

ii) Write down the mode.

[1]

iii) Write down the median.

[1]
parts.solution_md:
i) *For each option, find the total number of books read by multiplying the number of books by the frequency*

| Number of books read | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Frequency | $2$ | $2$ | $16$ | $10$ | $9$ | $4$ | $x$ | $2$ |
| *Total number of books read* | *2* | *4* | *48* | *40* | *45* | *24* | $7x$ | *16* |

> *Find an expression for the total number of books read by adding together all the totals*

> *Simplify the expression*

$2+4+48+40+45+24+7x+16=7x+179$

**[1]**

> *Find an expression for the total frequency by adding together all the frequencies*

> *Simplify the expression*

$2+2+16+10+9+4+x+2=x+45$

> *The mean is the total number of books read divided by the total frequency*

> *Use the given mean to form an equation*

$\frac{7x+179}{x+45}=4.28$

**[1]**

> *Multiply both sides by *$x+45$* and expand*

$\begin{gathered} 7 x + 179 & = 4.28 ( x + 45 ) \\ 7 x + 179 & = 4.28 x + 192.6 \end{gathered}$

> *Rearrange to get all the **x** terms on one side by themselves*

> *Subtract 4.28**x** from both sides and subtract 179 from both sides*

> *Simplify both sides*

$\begin{gathered} 7 x - 4.28 x & = 192.6 - 179 \\ 2.72 x & = 13.6 \end{gathered}$

> *Divide both sides by 2.72*

$x=\frac{13.6}{2.72}$

$x=5$ **[1]**

ii) *The mode is the option with the highest frequency*

**Mode is 3 books** **[1]**

iii) *Find the total frequency by substituting *$x=5$* into the expression from part (a) *$x+45.$

$5+45=50$

> *The median is the middle value when the values are in order from smallest to biggest*

> *Instead of writing out all 50 values, you can consider where the middle would be*

> *The median is the midpoint between the 25*<sup>*th*</sup>* and 26*<sup>*th*</sup>* values*

> *Find the cumulative frequencies*

| Number of books read | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| *Cumulative Frequency* | *2* | *4* | *20* | *30* | *39* | *43* | *48* | *50* |

> *Both the 25*<sup>*th*</sup>* and 26*<sup>*th*</sup>* values are 4 so the midpoint between them is also 4*

**Median is 4 books** **[1]**

Find the range of scores for all the students in both classes.

*Find the lowest overall score in both classes (the smaller of the two lowest class scores)*

*lowest overall score is 33*

*The range is the difference between the highest and lowest values* *Find the highest score in Class A (by adding its range to its lowest score)*
